verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP directory, hosting and gateway platform, so publishing its own official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows Glama hosting, proxying, inspecting and cataloguing third-party MCP servers. The Gateway endpoint fronts servers you deploy rather than exposing Glama's own capabilities, so it is an adjacent capability. No first-party Glama MCP server for its directory or platform functions is documented; the directory is exposed only as a REST/OpenAPI API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
